title: RPM & Offline Package Administration
purpose: Eight connected real-guest activities: inspect trusted archives, observe dependency failure, apply exact local transactions, preserve configuration and recover package-owned data. Sequence is guidance, not an unlock.
prerequisites: Earlier Debian package, access, quoting, status and original-preservation lessons. This distinct AlmaLinux image only; no fallback to Debian or another guest.
coverage: LPIC-1 active v5.0 partial 102.5 RPM lifecycle/integrity and DNF4 awareness. Not full YUM/Zypper coverage. Completion is self-reviewed and unscored.
